mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.status, p.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eval_criterion c WHERE c.position_id = p.id) AS criteria_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate d WHERE d.position_id = p.id) AS candidate_count FROM position p ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position (title, jd_text, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{jdText}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE position SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE position SET image_text = #{imageText} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE position SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
